author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted - Paid Opportunities
content: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES. Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027. If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work. Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required. These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only. Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability: Email: craiggroshek@chillingtalesfordarknights.com Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST

author: Jobs.com
title: Hiring Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist Fully Remote for Turing
content: HIRING! Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist Fully Remote. https://work.turing.com/r/BpA6o2F8Jm Role Overview: We are looking for talented Illustrators, Sketchers, Cartoonists, Digital Artists, and Concept Artists who can create high-quality artwork from reference images while introducing creative variations and maintaining the character’s identity. This opportunity is open to interns, freshers, emerging artists, and experienced professionals. Create digital character illustrations and sketches using provided reference images. Produce creative variations while maintaining character identity. Apply core fundamentals of composition, color, lighting, perspective, and proportion. Adapt artwork across diverse visual themes. Deliver polished, high-quality artwork within assigned project timelines.
